verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a customer data platform, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk-operation capability. That means no batch edit, batch delete, or multi-item action via UI or API. Warehouse Sync describes ingesting warehouse data into mParticle, which is a data-pipeline feature rather than a documented capability to act on many items at once, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
